countdown.title: Girl or boy?
countdown.welcome: Wherever we all are, the clock hits zero at the same instant for everyone. Get your guess in before it does.
countdown.voteErrorNotice: We could not save your guess. Try again.
countdown.offlineNotice: No connection to the server. Retrying…

reveal.headline: It's official
reveal.subtitle: Thank you for being here, even from far away.
reveal.noVote: You made it just in time for the good part.

forge.title: One instant, the whole world over
forge.lead: Pick the hour and the answer, write whatever you want people to read, and walk away with a link to share. The clock hits zero at the same time for everyone, wherever they are.
forge.secretHint: It lives on the server alone. It reaches nobody's browser until the hour passes.
forge.previewTooFar: That is more than {days} days out. Pick something closer.
forge.colorsHint: These two make the whole palette: the balloons, the cards, the confetti and the sky at the end.
forge.votingSwitchHint: Turn it off and the page is just the countdown.
forge.votersSwitch: Show who guessed what at the end
forge.votersSwitchHint: With this off, zero brings the numbers only.
forge.revealTextsHint: None of this reaches a browser until the hour passes, so write what you like without worrying that somebody will peek.
forge.fine: Up to {days} days ahead. The link and the guesses are kept until {retention} days after the reveal.

done.title: Your countdown exists
done.guestsWhy: Share it with whoever you like. Nobody who opens it can see the answer until the hour you picked.
done.secretWhyBefore: This one shows you how the guessing is going without having to guess, and lets you change the wording, the colours and the hour.
done.secretWhyAfter: : whoever holds it can rewrite your countdown.
done.fine: Save both links somewhere other than this browser. There is no account and no way to recover them. The countdown and its guesses are deleted {retention} days after the reveal.

errors.invalid_time: Check the date, the time and the zone.
errors.time_in_past: That time has passed. Pick a moment in the future.
errors.invalid_color: Colours have to be hex, like #ff6f9c.
errors.invalid_text: One of the texts came out too long.
errors.invalid_payload: We could not read the form. Try again.
errors.horizon_exceeded: Countdowns cannot be set more than {days} days ahead.
errors.generic: We could not save that. Try again.

panel.leadOpen: {left} to go. Nobody knows the answer yet, and you will not see it here early either.
panel.leadDone: It has hit zero. Open the link to see the reveal.
panel.shareHint: This is the one to pass around. Not the one this page is on.
panel.votingOff: Guessing is switched off for this countdown.
panel.editHint: It applies to the link you already shared. The answer is not editable here.
panel.lockedFine: The setup can no longer be changed: the moment has passed. Everything is deleted {retention} days later.

notFound.title: This countdown does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or the party was more than a month ago and its data has been deleted.

reveal.headline: Kicker
reveal.girlText: If it is a girl, it reads
reveal.boyText: If it is a boy, it reads
reveal.subtitle: Subtitle
reveal.votersMore: If the list is cut short · uses {count}
